site.name: AURA Agentic Web
site.description: AURA's portable multi-agent brain published as an open agentic network: a plan/research/build/verify/critique loop any conforming runtime can load and run in the browser.

default_router.note: Site-provided default is a placeholder; visitors are expected to use the BYOK panel to supply their own OpenAI-compatible router + key. No publisher credential ships in this manifest.

networks.name: aura-core
networks.description: AURA's core orchestration network: an orchestrator front agent that delegates to researcher, builder, verifier, and critic agents in a plan-work-verify-repair loop.

peer_links.note: Named references to other published agent-network URLs can be added here. The runtime also accepts a direct peer URL whose final path component is the network name.

peer_policy.note: This demo site permits loading peer agent networks from any origin, subject to per-contact user consent enforced by the runtime and browser CORS.
